column1: # The photo review's swap suggestions (matchFoods, top 3) for the English review's 50 typical item names.
# Columns: item, before (the code and the 348 foods of git 3fa7914), now (today's code and foods).
# Text without a Hebrew letter is scored exactly as before (localMatch.test.ts proves it against a copy of the
# old scorer); a "now" that differs from "before" comes only from the foods added in this job and the new rows'
# names. Every food of git 3fa7914 keeps its English name of that time (lead's ruling G1b, which withdrew the
# fat-percentage renames of the second fix round), so "Cheddar cheese", "Feta cheese" and "Granola with yogurt"
# offer what they offered before that round.
# Ruling G9 (second fix round): "Fruit salad" no longer offers the fruit yogurt first (renamed "Yogurt with
# fruit, 3% fat"), and the last line, "Cheese omelette", no longer the baked cheesecake (renamed "Cheesecake,
# baked, made with 5% quark"). Rewrite "now" with
# HEALTHCAL_RECORD_AI=1 npx vitest run src/features/ai/localMatch.test.ts after reading every changed line.
